migration: 3 Bot Prefabs saved using PrefabUtility. Remaining mission/socket/effect data and GUIDs preserved. Removed old navigation fields; base Bot explicitly persists existing requiresPower=true default.
limitations: 10 isolated PhysX navigation scenes; no arbitrary maze or swarm validation.
Initial 30 m/s braking case is slower: 3.24s versus 2.18s previously.
Single runs are diagnostic comparisons, not statistical benchmarks.
Search range, repair capability, pickup, sockets and presentation remain editable; navigation/docking is fixed in code.
